text.autoconfig.autotools.title: AutoTools Config
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.general: AutoTools will always be active and try to get you the best tool. Can be toggled with the set key.
Disables AutoTools in creative-mode if toggle is disabled
Keeps the selected slot when swapping to a new tool instead of using the vanilla mechanics
AutoTools will only select tool from you hotbar
AutoTools will switch to an item with no durability if no suitable tool has been found
AutoTools will prefer the tool already in your hotbar if multiple tools have the same mining speed, regardless their durability
AutoTools will prefer the tool with the lower durability, instead of the higher one, if they have the same mining speed
Autotools will use Fortune for Gravel and Leaves
AutoTools will only switch items if you can't mine a block with your current one
AutoTools will switch back to the previous tool or item you had in your hand before breaking the block
Displays the weapons Dps when hovering over it
AutoTools will change to the tool with the most DPS when looking at an entity
AutoTools won't change to a better weapon(e.g. a sword) when holding an axe
Autotools additionally will prefer Silk Touch even if it isn't required to mine a block:
AutoTools will only work and swap to the best tool if you are already holding:
AutoTools won't do anything if the currently selected one of these:
AutoTools only puts tools in these slots:

If < 1: Seen as a percentage: Tools below minDurability won't be selected
Else: Seen as durability: tools will be selected until at minDurability (e.g. set to 1 to never break a tool)
Prevents mining when going under minDurability

[Experimental] Adds an experimental 1 Tick = 50ms delay if toggle is enabled before breaking a block after a tool switch.
Enable this only if you are experiencing Desyncs like Ghost-Blocks when instant mining.
text.autoconfig.autotools.option.blockLi: Silk Touch
AutoTools will always prefer tools with Silk Touch for blocks inside this list. Intended for blocks that only drop when mined with Silk Touch
Prefer Silk Touch: Always
If Prefer Silk Touch: Always, AutoTools will prefer tools with Silk Touch for blocks inside this list
Prefer Silk Touch: Except ores
If Prefer Silk Touch: Except ores, AutoTools will prefer tools with Silk Touch for blocks inside this list
Prefer Silk Touch: Ores
If Prefer Silk Touch: Ores, AutoTools will prefer tools with Silk Touch for blocks inside this list
Fortune
AutoTools will always prefer tools with Fortune (after Silk Touch) for blocks inside this list. Intended for blocks whose drops are affected by Fortune
Always Prefer Fortune
If Always Prefer Fortune, AutoTools will always prefer tools with Fortune (before Silk Touch) for blocks inside this list
Shears
AutoTools will always prefer Shears for blocks inside this list
Do not swap unless enchantment
AutoTools will only swap for blocks inside this list if it finds an enchanted tool. Intended for instant-mineable blocks that benefit from enchantments
Enable Datapacks
AutoTools will also include blocks inside the lists added by third party mods and datapacks
Custom Tools

Add custom tool-configurations in JSON format
e.g. "minecraft:block_id":"minecraft:tool_id" or "minecraft:block_id":["minecraft:tool_id_1", "minecraft:tool_id_2"]
When adding multiple tools, the first one has the highest priority.
Also supports block and item tags.
Use "autotools:disabled" to disable AutoTools on a certain block.
Also works for entities: "minecraft:entity_id":"minecraft:tool_id
